pull_method: WRDS web query builder (CRSP Stock - Version 2 (CIZ), Monthly), not scripts/pull/crsp-monthly.py
query: SELECT permno, primaryexch, siccd, mthcaldt, mthprc, mthret, mthretx, shrout FROM crsp.msf_v2 WHERE sharetype = 'NS' AND securitytype = 'EQTY' AND securitysubtype = 'COM' AND usincflg = 'Y' AND (issuertype = 'ACOR' OR issuertype = 'CORP') AND (primaryexch = 'N' OR primaryexch = 'A' OR primaryexch = 'Q')
universe: US common stock (CIZ NS/EQTY/COM, issuer ACOR/CORP, US-incorporated), NYSE/AMEX/NASDAQ (primaryexch N/A/Q). CIZ mthret is already delisting-adjusted; returns are decimal (0.0289 = +2.89%).
post_download_cleanup: Stripped identifier columns (HdrCUSIP, Ticker, PERMCO) and post-filter-constant descriptor columns (USIncFlg, IssuerType, SecurityType, SecuritySubType, ShareType) that the WRDS web export bundled in, to honor the permno-only design in README.md. No rows dropped.
license: CRSP via WRDS - raw file is git-ignored; ship only aggregates.
